  giveninits=true,
  uniquename=init,
  dashed=false
]{biblatex}
\addbibresource{references.bib}
\DeclareCiteCommand{\parencite}[\mkbibbrackets]

  {\usebibmacro{citeindex}\usebibmacro{cite}}
  {}
  {\usebibmacro{postnote}}
\usepackage[
  colorlinks=true,
  linkcolor=blue,
  citecolor=blue,
  urlcolor=blue,
  bookmarksnumbered=true
]{hyperref}
\usepackage{bookmark}

\input{metadata}

  pdftitle={\ProposalTitle},
  pdfauthor={\StudentName},
  pdfsubject={Research proposal template}
}
\setlist{nosep,topsep=0.5\baselineskip}
\setcounter{secnumdepth}{2}
\setcounter{tocdepth}{2}
\AddToHook{cmd/section/before}{\Needspace{5\baselineskip}}
\renewcommand{\bibname}{References}
\renewcommand*{\bibfont}{\small}
\setlength{\bibitemsep}{0.4\baselineskip}
\pagestyle{plain}

% Visible writing prompts. Replace each use with your own prose.
% Citations can be written as \parencite{key} or \textcite{key}.
\newcommand{\placeholder}[1]{{\color{black!60}\textit{[#1]}}}
\newcommand{\frontmatterheading}[1]{%
  \begin{center}\large\bfseries #1\end{center}%
  \vspace{0.5\baselineskip}%
}
